# DataDolphin

> DataDolphin PTE. LTD. is a Singapore-based AI and data technology company that builds sophisticated data applications and provides expert consultancy in data engineering, machine learning, and AI integration.

## About

DataDolphin pioneers advanced data engineering and data science applications. We combine deep technical expertise with an innovative, product-first approach to build powerful tools for data transformation, analysis, and AI-driven insights. We operate our own portfolio of AI-powered consumer products, giving us hands-on product experience that directly benefits our consulting clients.

- Company: DataDolphin PTE. LTD.
- Location: Singapore
- Website: https://datadolphin.net
- Email: info@datadolphin.net

## Services

- **Application Development**: Design and development of custom data applications for web and mobile platforms using Flutter (iOS & Android), React, and modern web technologies with AI-powered features.
- **AI & Data Consultancy**: Expert strategy and hands-on implementation in data engineering, LLM integration, agentic workflows, ETL pipeline architecture, ML model deployment, and cloud infrastructure on GCP.
- **Training & Support**: Comprehensive workshops and ongoing support for AI/ML teams — covering LLM prompt engineering, data pipeline best practices, and AI integration.

## Products

- **Looksmax Report** — AI-powered facial analysis mobile app (iOS & Android). Provides detailed analysis and personalised improvement recommendations. [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/looksmax-report/id6737451002) | [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rsapps.looksmaxreport)
- **Attractiveness AI** — Advanced AI app for facial feature analysis with detailed attractiveness insights (iOS, Android & Web). [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/attractiveness-ai/id6741153581) | [Website](https://attractivenessai.com/)
- **Rate My Photo** — AI-powered web platform for professional photo analysis and quality feedback. [Website](https://rate-my-photo.com/)
- **Attractiveness Test** — AI-powered web platform for comprehensive facial analysis and attractiveness scoring. [Website](https://attractivenesstest.com/)
- **SkinMax — AI Skincare** — AI skincare analysis platform delivering personalised skin health insights and product recommendations. [Website](https://howolddoyoulook.com/skincare)

## Technology Stack

- AI & Machine Learning (computer vision, deep learning, precision inference)
- LLM Integration & Prompt Design (GPT, Claude, Gemini)
- Agentic Workflows (autonomous AI systems, multi-step reasoning)
- Flutter (cross-platform iOS & Android development)
- ETL Pipelines (Apache Airflow, DBT)
- Python & SQL (data engineering, analytics, backend)
- Data Processing (streaming and batch architectures)
- Google Cloud Platform — GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI)
